name: Do you repair all types of gates, including automatic and manual?

mainEntity.name: Do you repair all types of gates, including automatic and manual?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Frasheski Construction provides repair services for a wide variety of gates, encompassing both automatic (electric) and manual systems. This includes swing gates, sliding gates, cantilever gates, and pedestrian gates, whether they are residential driveway gates or commercial security gates. We handle issues ranging from mechanical failures and structural damage to electrical system malfunctions and sensor problems. Our expertise extends across different materials and operating mechanisms to ensure comprehensive service for clients throughout our service areas, including Albany and Oakland.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we repair all types of gates, including automatic and manual systems, covering mechanical, structural, and electrical issues for residential and commercial gates.
